items.name: PLOSIVE_CONSONANT_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#cons_db

items.doc: How far a hard consonant (t, k) is cut in its band, dB, at full contrast: y = x1 + (g - 1) B, the de-esser's split, so no gain is added at any frequency. 0 cuts nothing, bit for bit.

items.name: PLOSIVE_SENSITIVITY_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#cons_s

items.doc: The contrast, dB between the band's fast and slow envelopes (omx_envdiff), a burst must pass before the consonant cut starts; the cut is full TRANSIENT_REF_DB past it (omx_envdiff_ramp). A contrast, not a level: the same t is treated the same at any gain.

items.name: PLOSIVE_RECOVERY_MS_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#cons_rec

items.doc: The consonant detector's slow attack, ms: how long a burst's contrast lasts, so how long the cut does.

items.name: PLOSIVE_BAND_HZ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#band_hz

items.doc: The consonant band's centre, Hz: the de-esser's cookbook bandpass section.

items.name: PLOSIVE_BAND_WIDTH_OCT_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#band_oct

items.doc: The consonant band's width, octaves; its top edge is held under PLOSIVE_BAND_EDGE_FRACTION of the rate.

items.name: PLOSIVE_POP_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#pop_db

items.doc: How far a p pop is cut below popHz, dB, at full contrast: x1 = x - (1 - g) LP, the low half of a first-order power-complementary split, so no gain is added. 0 cuts nothing, bit for bit.

items.name: PLOSIVE_POP_SENSITIVITY_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#pop_s

items.doc: The contrast, dB, the pop band's burst must pass before the pop cut starts.

items.name: PLOSIVE_POP_RECOVERY_MS_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#pop_rec

items.doc: The pop detector's slow attack, ms.

items.name: PLOSIVE_POP_HZ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#pop_hz

items.doc: The pop split's corner, Hz: the first-order allpass (omx_allpass1) whose halves are the pop band and the rest.

items.name: PLOSIVE_BAND_EDGE_FRACTION

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/plosive.json at af15c3bccdb6, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_plosive_instance.h#OMX_PLOSIVE_INSTANCE_EDGE

items.doc: The consonant band's top edge is held under this share of the rate, the de-esser's rule: the band is redesigned from its held edges, so the clamp is never silent.
